title: UFHF - Underactuated Finger Mechanism with Haptic Feedback
content: Combining a Haptic Feedback and Sensing Glove (HFG) with an Underactuated Finger Mechanism (UFM), this concept aims to replicate the complex motion of human fingers in a robotic system, providing bi-directional control and haptic feedback to enhance user experience and precision in robotic applications.
